intent: Remove the operator-control HMAC key fingerprint and credential path from campaign argv/config propagation. The sole campaign writer may load only the fixed control_hmac_key entry beneath systemd's CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY, using no-follow, exact-file, ownership, mode, link-count, and stable-read custody checks. Neither the key nor any secret-derived value may enter argv, environment variables, logs, errors, receipts, projections, or snapshots. Missing or malformed custody and wrong verification keys fail closed; this packet creates no new control authority, transport, deployment unit, or external effect.

commit.message: fix(runtime): keep operator HMAC under systemd custody

interface_mismatches: The current campaign CLI accepts and propagates both a credential path and SHA-256 of the credential, placing secret-derived material in argv and process inspection surfaces.
The current loader treats a caller-supplied digest as custody proof even though a digest of a symmetric HMAC key is itself sensitive, exportable material.
The systemd runtime contract already provides a credential directory, so production does not need an independently configurable key path or fingerprint.
honest_blockers: Local tests use disposable credential files and do not prove a real systemd LoadCredential deployment.
HMAC verification necessarily reads the key into the sole writer's private process memory; this packet prevents export through configuration and evidence surfaces, not same-process memory compromise.

A credential signed by an unintended but correctly custodied key cannot be distinguished without an out-of-band key identity; operational rotation must atomically update publishers and the systemd credential source.
No external service, VPS, provider, public route, Git remote, or systemd unit may be mutated by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Keep campaign dispatch stopped, preserve control inboxes and terminal receipts for forensic inspection, and revert this private branch commit. Do not restore the credential fingerprint to argv; deploy only after an equivalent systemd-credential custody path is present.
